Subject: Trifecta AI — tri-geography dedicated capacity alignment

Hi team,

Following our demo yesterday, Trifecta (Raj) is ready to move toward a dedicated capacity commitment that spans US + EU + APAC. Attached is the demand model they shared (demand_model_v2.xlsx).

High level ask from the customer:
- Target go-live: 2026-08-01 (Q3 ramp)
- Steady-state throughput: ~120M tokens/day globally
- Peak concurrent sessions: ~2.2k (mostly short chat + some batch generation)
- Model mix: 70% 13B-class, 30% 70B-class (for higher-quality responses)
- Latency SLO: 95th <= 450ms for chat paths

Can infra provide a tri-region sketch (US/EU/APAC) with:
1) conservative sizing (standby buffer + 20% buffer)
2) optimized sizing (aggressive batching + KV cache assumptions)

Please call out lead times, preferred instance SKUs, and recommended burst capacity for first 90 days. Need a short internal note by EOD Friday so I can confirm numbers with Raj & procurement.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.inference>

Date: 2026-05-10T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trifecta AI — tri-geography dedicated capacity alignment

Ben/Karthik — quick first-pass after importing the demand model. I attached a spreadsheet with the estimate (initial-sizing-estimate.xlsx).

Assumptions we used:
- 13B model: 4.8 tokens/ms on A100-80GB-equivalent; 70B model: 6.5 tokens/ms on H100-class.
- Token distribution by region: US 50% / EU 30% / APAC 20% (customer stated preference)
- Cache hit rate (prefix KV caching): baseline 28%, optimistic 45% for repeat prompts
- Batching: conservative 12 reqs/batch, optimized 28 reqs/batch for asynchronous workloads

Two recommended configurations (steady-state with 20% overhead):
1) Conservative (fast fail-safe)
   - US: 18 H100 nodes (sustained) + 6 spare for burst
   - EU: 10 H100 nodes + 3 spare
   - APAC: 6 H100 nodes + 2 spare
   - Observability: per-node token accounting and per-route latency SLO alerts
   - Estimated lead time (provisioning + testing): 6–8 weeks

2) Optimized (cost-aware)
   - US: 13 H100 nodes (sustained) + 3 spare
   - EU: 8 H100 nodes + 2 spare
   - APAC: 4 H100 nodes + 1 spare
   - Requires enabling larger batch windows, TTLs for KV cache set to 45s
   - Estimated lead time: 4–6 weeks (assuming SKU availability)

Notes & questions:
- Do we want preemptible burst lanes in APAC (cheaper but riskier)?
- Confirm expected 95th-latency SLOs for batch vs chat paths (current sketch assumes chat 95th=450ms)
- Need procurement constraints from Trifecta (term length / early termination / true-up cadence)

I can convert option 1 into a SOW draft once you confirm which direction the customer prefers.

—Irene
[attachment: initial-sizing-estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet, 88KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>

Subject: Re: Trifecta AI — tri-geography dedicated capacity alignment

Raj — thanks for the time. Internal options attached are:

- Conservative (higher headroom, safer for fast growth)
- Optimized (saves ~18% unit cost with batching + cache tuning)

Quick asks for you so we can finalize the SOW:
- Confirm region split (we sketched US50/EU30/APAC20)
- Confirm willingness to use APAC preemptible lanes for burst (saves ~25%)
- Confirm target contract term (12 months preferred for reserved pricing)

If okay, can we book a 30m call tomorrow to lock the option? I’ve added the HubSpot mutual action plan here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/890123

Thanks,
Ben
